name: Marurun
source:
"Gods... please grant me strength to carry out vengeance. Grant me strength......... gods... gods..."

A girl who fights to avenge her parents. She shows no mercy if it's for vengeance. She is taciturn and only speaks with low voice, but sometimes changes her attitude depending on the person. She often prays to gods. The gods reside in her hands when she prays, allowing her to "massage" with elegant handiwork.
